description.blurb: Skrymir (formerly S/2004 S23 and Saturn LVI) is a natural satellite of Saturn discovered in 2004 and announced in 2019.
description.more: In mythology, Skrymir is a Norse giant who is a master of illusions. Skrymir is about 4 kilometres in diameter, and orbits Saturn in 1149.82 days, at an inclination of 177° to the ecliptic.​
